lastFeature: mobile-wide-tables (New Feature) — SHIPPED 0.5.69. Desktop (macOS universal + Windows) live via release.sh on Hephaestus (GitHub release v0.5.69 + latest.json); iOS 0.5.69 build 1 uploaded to TestFlight. A comfortable Breeding Codes matrix on phones: at <=640 the code columns narrow to ~30px dot-width (.sr-bc-code-col) with 0.625rem headers + native viewport pinch to magnify (no CSS zoom); thin vertical column rules (--sr-border-subtle on .sr-bc-code-col/.sr-bc-name-col) at all widths; a horizontally-sticky species-name column; and a NATURAL full-height page-scrolling table with the tier legend after the last row. Notable: a frozen-title-row + capped-height data-grid was built and live-tested, then REVERTED at the user's request — pure CSS can't combine a frozen-to-page header + an unbounded table + contained horizontal scroll (overflow-x:auto forces overflow-y to auto/hidden). Multimedia table untouched (already fine on phone). iOS build gotcha fixed + recorded in CLAUDE.md: tauri ios build --export-method app-store-connect needs APPLE_API_KEY/APPLE_API_ISSUER/APPLE_API_KEY_PATH env (distinct from altool's $APPLE_API_KEY_ID/$APPLE_API_ISSUER_ID). Feature commit 6da3645; records commit 28912da; iOS Info.plist stamped 0.5.69/0.5.69.1.
